what.text: This page follows refugees from Somalia living in Canada, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2140 Somali refugees in Canada, 0.2% of all refugees from Somalia.
Kenya and Ethiopia host the most Somali refugees, followed by Uganda and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia in periods from 1989 to 2025, with Al-Shabaab among the opponents since 2006.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Somalia from 2019 to 2021 and in 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at its highest figure, 17817 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1994 to 1997, and the figure has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
These are year-end totals for Canada only, reported to UNHCR.
